sentences.text: Prescott -LRB- -LSB- ˈprɛskət -RSB- ; ʼWi : kwatha Ksikʼita -RRB- is a city in Yavapai County , Arizona , United States .	Yavapai County	Yavapai County, Arizona	Arizona	Arizona	County	List of counties in Arizona	United States	United States	Yavapai	Yavapai County, Arizona	city	city
According to the 2010 Census , the population of the city is 39,843 .	2010	2010 United States Census	city	city
The city is the county seat of Yavapai County .	Yavapai County	Yavapai County, Arizona	County	List of counties in Arizona	Yavapai	Yavapai County, Arizona	city	city	county seat	county seat

In 1864 Prescott was designated as the capital of the Arizona Territory , replacing the temporary capital at Fort Whipple .	Arizona	Arizona	Arizona Territory	Arizona Territory	Fort Whipple	Fort Whipple, Arizona
The Territorial Capital was moved to Tucson in 1867 .	Tucson	Tucson, Arizona
Prescott again became the Territorial Capital in 1877 , until Phoenix became the capital in 1889 .	Phoenix	Phoenix, Arizona

The towns of Prescott Valley , 7 mi east ; Chino Valley , 16 mi north ; Dewey-Humboldt , 13 mi east , and Prescott , together comprise what is locally known as the `` Quad-City '' area .	City	City	Prescott Valley	Prescott Valley, Arizona	Chino Valley	Chino Valley, Arizona	Dewey-Humboldt	Dewey-Humboldt

This also sometimes refers to central Yavapai County in general , which would include the towns of : Mayer , Paulden , Wilhoit , and Williamson Valley .	Yavapai County	Yavapai County, Arizona	County	List of counties in Arizona	Yavapai	Yavapai County, Arizona	Mayer	Mayer, Arizona	Paulden	Paulden	Wilhoit	Wilhoit, Arizona
Combined with these smaller communities the area had a population of 103,260 .

Prescott is the center of the Prescott Metropolitan Area , defined by the U.S. Census Bureau as all of Yavapai County .	Yavapai County	Yavapai County, Arizona	County	List of counties in Arizona	Yavapai	Yavapai County, Arizona
